  have h₁ : (excedances π) = Finset.filter (fun i => π i > i) Finset.univ := by
    rfl
  
  have h₂ : (coexcedances π⁻¹) = Finset.filter (fun i => (π⁻¹) i < i) Finset.univ := by
    rfl
  
  have h₃ : Finset.image π (excedances π) = coexcedances π⁻¹ := by
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    apply Finset.ext
    intro x
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · -- Prove the forward direction: if x is in the image of excedances π, then x is in coexcedances π⁻¹
      rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      -- Since π i > i and π is a permutation, we have (π⁻¹) (π i) = i < π i
      have h₄ : (π⁻¹) (π i) < π i := by
        have h₅ : (π⁻¹) (π i) = i := by
          simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
        rw [h₅]
        exact hi
      exact h₄
    · -- Prove the backward direction: if x is in coexcedances π⁻¹, then x is in the image of excedances π
      rintro h
      -- Since (π⁻¹) x < x, we have i = (π⁻¹) x < x and π i = x > i
      refine' ⟨(π⁻¹) x, _⟩
      have h₅ : (π⁻¹) x < x := h
      have h₆ : π ((π⁻¹) x) = x := by
        simp [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      have h₇ : (π⁻¹) x < (π⁻¹) x + 1 := by
        omega
      have h₈ : x > (π⁻¹) x := by
        omega
      have h₉ : π ((π⁻¹) x) > (π⁻¹) x := by
        rw [h₆]
        exact h₈
      exact h₉
  have h₄ : (excedances π).card = (coexcedances π⁻¹).card := by
    have h₅ : Finset.card (Finset.image π (excedances π)) = Finset.card (coexcedances π⁻¹) := by
      rw [h₃]
    have h₆ : Finset.card (Finset.image π (excedances π)) = Finset.card (excedances π) := by
      apply Finset.card_image_of_injective
      intro a b hab
      apply Perm.injective
      exact hab
    rw [h₆] at h₅
    exact h₅
  exact h₄

MSC-180/08_001.informal_statement: Let $A$ be an algebra generated by a set $X$. If $\alpha: A \to B$ and $\beta: A \to B$ are two homomorphisms which agree on $X$ (i.e., $\alpha(a) = \beta(a)$ for $a \in X$), then $\alpha = \beta$.

      have h₆ : p ≤ b := h₃.2
      have h₇ : a ≤ q := h₄.1
